WHY_I_FIT:
Trilegal requires an associate who combines rigorous legal research with commercial context. Across three years at **Gandhi & Co.**, I have managed commercial dispute filings before High Courts, drafting petitions and arbitration submissions. My quantitative MBA training from **IIM Sirmaur** enables me to analyze financial disclosures, damages claims, and transaction contracts with commercial acumen that purely doctrinal practitioners lack. Having also launched a commercial venture (**Naraina Jewellers**), I approach client matters with owner mindset and zero defect compliance.

My courtroom experience spans end to end case management, from drafting initial pleadings and statutory notices to framing evidentiary affidavits and coordinating with senior advocates for High Court appearances. In parallel, my business education provides working proficiency in financial modeling, valuation assessment, and corporate governance frameworks. This dual lens allows me to quickly deconstruct complex corporate transactions, evaluate regulatory exposure under company law and arbitration statutes, and draft airtight contractual safeguards for institutional clients.

Whether preparing urgent interim relief petitions, synthesizing dense case precedents across judicial benches, or negotiating commercial terms with counterparties, I deliver disciplined execution, clear written advocacy, and complete ownership across every matter.
